zh-CN.title: 广场浏览更连贯
items: 打开和关闭发言详情时保留广场列表，避免瀑布流闪烁重排
个人资料请求采用无损压缩，减少加载流量，资料与功能保持完整

en.title: Smoother Square browsing
items: Keep the Square feed mounted when opening and closing post details to avoid masonry flicker
Lossless profile compression reduces loading traffic while preserving all data and features
